summary: Frontend-only verification of ABC Supply settings page (/admin/settings/abc) UX additions in MOCK mode. All acceptance criteria met: page renders, mock banner visible (1), amber redirect callout correctly hidden (0) in mock mode, OAuth Redirect URI field present with adjacent Copy button, Copy click triggers a toast without any uncaught JS exception (headless clipboard blocked so error toast 'Could not copy — select and copy manually' shown, which is acceptable per spec), and no regression: Test connection / Save defaults present, Reconnect + Disconnect visible (already connected from prior mock run).
critical_code_review_comments: Copy handler falls back gracefully in headless with an error toast — good UX. In real browsers with clipboard permission, the success toast 'Redirect URI copied' will fire.
Two console 500s observed during initial dashboard load (unrelated to ABC settings page); worth main agent verifying which endpoints these are, though they do not affect the ABC settings UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview environment is in ABC MOCK mode (ABC_MOCK_ENABLED=true). Owner account is already connected to mock ABC (EASY ROOFING 116660), so abc-connect-button will NOT render; abc-reconnect-button + abc-disconnect-button render instead. Amber abc-redirect-callout is intentionally hidden here. To test the amber callout gating you would need mock mode OFF and no existing connection.
